verdict.rationale: Bruno has no documented programmatic API, and the OpenAPI probe found nothing. Its own capabilities still give agents and scripts real non-UI access: the official bru CLI runs collections with env overrides and reports. Collections are stored as plain-text Bru files that the product explicitly positions for Git, IDEs, and agents, so they can be authored and edited without the GUI. Missing for 10: a documented API or CLI covering full UI parity (Git UI, AI features, apps, auth flows, settings), an OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of how far file/CLI-based automation reaches.
